threat_event: Ransomware operator uses a phished administrator laptop and its sessions to encrypt the integration server, delete the export copies, and delete or alter records in the agency workspaces
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrators use their privileged accounts for email and browsing on the same laptop; SSH keys without passphrases; exports in the same account as the server; no after-hours monitoring; no phishing training
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-9, IR-6); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
existing_controls: MFA on platform and suite; MSP antivirus; vendor platform backups
treatment_plan: Write-once exports in a separate account (2026-11-30); separate administrator accounts used only for administration (2026-10-31); MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting (2026-12-31); phishing training (2026-10-31); first restore test (2026-10-31)

threat_event: Theft of CJI and applicant Social Security numbers during an intrusion, followed by extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bulk export from the platform is allowed for every administrator; no alert on bulk exports or new-location sign-ins; CHRI files kept 30 days on SYS-02
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SI-4); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
treatment_plan: Alerts on bulk exports and administrator sign-ins (2026-10-31); delete CHRI working files after each load (2026-09-30); limit export rights to the Lead Platform Engineer (2026-09-30)

threat_event: A sheriff or state CJIS audit finds staff with CJI access who lack fingerprint-based checks and Security Addendum certification
threat_source: AC-01 or the state CJIS Systems Agency (audit)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support role reached every workspace; Support Analyst hired April 2026 never screened; no screening gate in onboarding
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3; Security Addendum sec. 2.01); 28 CFR 20.33(a)(7)
existing_controls: Support role narrowed to exclude AC-01 on 2026-08-12; 4 staff screened
treatment_plan: Fingerprint-based checks and Addendum certification for the Support Analyst through AC-01 (2026-10-15); screening gate before any CJI role (POL-02 B.2)

threat_event: Agency records cannot be restored within the 24-hour recovery time and 4-hour recovery point after accidental deletion, a bad configuration promotion, or attacker deletion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor restores only a whole tenant within 48 hours; company exports are nightly (24-hour recovery point) and never restore-tested; no contingency plan
existing_controls: Vendor continuous backup for platform failures
treatment_plan: Exports every 4 hours for AC-01 and AC-02 to write-once storage (2026-11-30); record-level restore procedure tested quarterly from 2026-10-31; contingency plan (2026-11-30); ask vendor for record-level restore at renewal

threat_event: The company tells an agency or the prime too late for it to meet its CJIS, IRS, or Florida 12-hour reporting duty
threat_source: Company process failure during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan before 2026-08-31; staff not briefed on the 1-hour rule; agency contact list not maintained
existing_controls: FTI spill reported the same day (2026-07-29)
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook approved 2026-08-31; staff briefing on the 1-hour rule (2026-09-15); printed contact card checked quarterly; tabletop with the MSP and AC-01 (2026-11-30)

threat_event: The May 2026 FTI spill into a company defect log leads the revenue agency or the IRS to suspend the subcontract, or a later spill goes unnoticed
threat_source: Integration Consultant (unintentional); weak agency session controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text paste into the agency virtual desktop is allowed, and nothing stops typing FTI into company files; no FTI handling rule before 2026-08-31
existing_controls: Spill reported 2026-07-29; file purged 2026-07-30; suite backup copies purged 2026-08-05
treatment_plan: No-FTI rule for company files (POL-04 4.5); defect log template with record keys only; quarterly scan of the suite for taxpayer ID patterns (2026-10-31); ask the agency to block text paste (through the prime)

threat_event: The revenue agency voids the subcontract after finding FTI access from an unapproved laptop or by a person whose recertification lapsed
threat_source: Revenue agency or IRS Office of Safeguards review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup person used his own laptop in June 2026; annual recertification overdue since June 2026; no tracking of agency requirements
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AC-20; Exhibit 7 II(4), I(13))
treatment_plan: Lead Platform Engineer suspended from SC-01 until recertified (done 2026-08-12); recertification (2026-09-15); disclose the June connections to the prime and agency (done 2026-08-14); calendar of agency renewals

threat_event: An incident cannot be scoped, and a CJIS audit cites short log retention, because platform logs roll off after 90 days and server logs after 14 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log export; no review
treatment_plan: Weekly export of platform and server logs to write-once storage, kept 1 year (2026-10-31); monthly review checklist (2026-10-31)

threat_event: Attacker compromises the integration server through an unpatched package or a stolen SSH key and reads or alters CJI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual patching 3 months behind; SSH keys without passphrases and no second factor; no malware protection
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SI-2, IA-2(1))
existing_controls: Security group limits SSH; provider disk encryption
treatment_plan: Automatic security updates and monthly scanning (2026-10-31); SSH only through the provider's MFA-protected session service, no public SSH (2026-12-31); passphrases on keys now (2026-09-15)

threat_event: A CJIS audit finds CJI pulled from the sheriff over a connection whose module is not FIPS 140-3 certified after 2026-09-21
threat_source: AC-01 or state CJIS Systems Agency audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default library on SYS-02; FIPS mode not enabled; no inventory of cryptographic modules
treatment_plan: Enable the operating system's FIPS 140-3 certified mode and verify the SFTP cipher list with sheriff IT (2026-09-18)

threat_event: Credential stuffing or phishing takes over AC-04 city accounts that sign in with a password only
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA not enabled for the AC-04 workspace
treatment_plan: Enable MFA for AC-04 with the city's agreement (2026-09-30)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management platform lets an attacker run commands on every laptop, reaching cached CJI and the SSH keys to the integration server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP technicians unscreened; MSP contract has no incident notice term; MFA on the MSP console not evidenced
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9, PS-3); Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate)
treatment_plan: MSP contract amendment: 24-hour incident notice, MFA evidence, named technicians, recovery commitment (2026-12-31); move SSH keys off laptops into the session service (R-009); no CJI files on laptops (POL-04)

threat_event: CJI in helpdesk ticket screenshots is disclosed through the helpdesk vendor, which has no CJIS Security Addendum
threat_source: Helpdesk vendor personnel or a breach of the vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sheriff users attach screenshots; vendor never reviewed
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9; Security Addendum sec. 2.01)
treatment_plan: Block attachments from AC-01 users and route sheriff support through a form inside the AC-01 workspace (2026-10-15); purge existing CJI attachments (2026-09-30); tell the AC-01 LASO (done 2026-08-14)

threat_event: Business email compromise of a staff mailbox exposes implementation files with agency data or redirects an agency payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA without number matching; no phishing training; agency data shared by email during implementations
treatment_plan: Number matching (2026-09-30); training and phishing exercises (2026-10-31); block automatic external forwarding (2026-09-30); call-back rule for bank detail changes

threat_event: AC-02 caseworkers adopt wrong AI pre-screening suggestions, leading to wrongful denials or delays for households facing eviction or shutoff
threat_source: AI add-on errors combined with automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation or human-review rule; suggestion shown before the caseworker reviews documents
treatment_plan: Add-on switched off 2026-09-01; restart only with the review-first design after validation and bias tests pass (P10)

threat_event: The AI add-on is less accurate for applicants with Spanish or Haitian Creole documents or with disability-related income, so those groups get more wrong suggestions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subgroup testing
treatment_plan: Subgroup error test on a 300-case re-worked sample before restart (2026-11-30); quarterly after (P10)

threat_event: Recovery or administration stalls because only the Lead Platform Engineer can rebuild the integration server or knows the tenant configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written rebuild procedure; no server image; second SSH key held by the owner but never used
treatment_plan: Rebuild script and image in the repository; the owner performs one practice rebuild (2026-11-30)

threat_event: Platform vendor outage lasts longer than the 24-hour contract recovery time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single platform; no alternate hosting
existing_controls: Vendor 99.9% availability commitment; FedRAMP Moderate; multi-zone platform
treatment_plan: Accepted by the owner: vendor history and SOC 2 report support the risk; agencies' paper workarounds cover 2 days. Recheck yearly

threat_event: AC-02 applicant data sent to the AI add-on outside the platform's FedRAMP scope is retained by the model subprocessor or used for training
threat_source: Platform vendor or its model subprocessor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Add-on terms not reviewed; full documents with Social Security numbers sent
existing_controls: Vendor states no training on customer data in its general terms
treatment_plan: Written no-training and retention terms from the vendor, and masking of Social Security numbers, before any restart (2026-10-31); otherwise keep the add-on off (P10)

threat_event: A lost or stolen laptop exposes cached CJI screenshots, agency exports, or SSH keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 8 laptops use 128-bit full-disk encryption; files with agency data kept in download folders
treatment_plan: Re-encrypt 3 laptops with 256-bit keys (2026-09-30); monthly clean-up of download folders

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office and disrupts staff and connectivity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; staff live nearby
existing_controls: No data in the office; staff can work from home or out of the area with laptops and phones
treatment_plan: Accepted by the owner: work moves to staff homes or out of the area; printed contact card kept by 3 staff

threat_event: A staff member looks at agency records without a work reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad read access for developers and support; no review of access logs
existing_controls: Role-based access; signed CJIS certifications for 4 staff
treatment_plan: Narrow developer production access (2026-10-31); monthly review of record views by staff (AU-6)

threat_event: At contract end or on a public records request, the company cannot produce or transfer an agency's records, or keeps exempt records it should have destroyed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written records transfer and deletion procedure; exports copied to the bucket
existing_controls: Contracts name each agency's records custodian
treatment_plan: Contract-end checklist: export, transfer at no cost, deletion with a certificate, public records requests forwarded the same day (2026-12-31)

threat_event: Attacker reaches the integration server over SSH through a security group rule left open to any internet address
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Temporary rule added in May 2026 for remote work and never removed (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Rule removed 2026-08-18, the day it was found; 14 days of available logs reviewed with no successful sign-in from an unknown address; change record required for security group changes (POL-02)

threat_event: Attacker who reads the repository uses the sheriff's file-drop password, stored in plain text in an interface script, to pull CJI
threat_source: Cybercriminal or a repository vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Secret in source code since 2024 (found in P07 testing); 5 repository users
treatment_plan: Sheriff IT rotated the password 2026-08-20; move the secret to the IaaS provider's secrets service and switch to key-based SFTP (2026-09-30); remove it from repository history
